meta.name: astropy
meta.description: Core Python library for astronomy and astrophysics workflows that need Astropy APIs, including units/quantities, coordinates, FITS I/O, tables, time systems, WCS, and cosmology. Use when implementing or debugging astronomical data analysis code with Astropy.

copy.tagline: 用 Astropy 进行天文与天体物理数据分析
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你是天文学家或天体物理学家，需要处理天文数据。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are an astronomer or astrophysicist working with astronomical data.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会调用专业天文软件库 Astropy 的代码,帮你读写天文数据文件(如 FITS)、换算天球坐标和单位、计算宇宙学距离等。遇到天文数据分析代码时,它也会协助编写与调试。
howto.when: 当你提出涉及天文数据分析的任务——比如换算天球坐标、读写 FITS 文件、做宇宙学或单位换算等——并需要以 Astropy 代码来实现或调试时触发。

say.text: 把这颗星的坐标从 ICRS 转到银道坐标,并给出 l、b。
读取这张 FITS 文件,列出各扩展结构,并输出图像数据的中位数。
用 Planck18 模型算 z=1.5 的光度距离和回溯时间,带单位。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude uses the professional astronomy code library Astropy to read/write FITS files, convert sky coordinates and units, compute cosmological distances, and help write or debug astronomical data-analysis code.
howto.when_en: It activates when the task involves implementing or debugging astronomical data analysis code with Astropy — e.g., coordinate transforms, FITS file reads/writes, or cosmology calculations.

say_en.text: Convert this star's coordinates from ICRS to Galactic and give l, b.
say_en.note: Will run an Astropy coordinate transform and output angles.

say_en.text: Read this FITS file, list its extensions, and print image median.
say_en.note: Will call astropy.io.fits and print structure and statistics.

say_en.text: Using Planck18, compute the luminosity distance and lookback time at z=1.5.
say_en.note: Will call astropy.cosmology and return unit-aware values.
